messages.subject: Volcano plot
parts:
Hi-

Is there anyway you can add a feature to specify the log scale on the volcano plot.  I know the current setting is defined by what was selected in the dataprocess step, but for most of our analysis (gene/protein) use log2 for fold change and then log 10 for volcano plots. 

-Chris

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: Volcano plot
parts:
Hi Chris,

We put this option on our todo list. Meanwhile, if you are working with MSstats through the command line, there is a very simple workaround. Take the output of groupComparison (such as the one on p.21 of the MSstats user guide), transform the estimate of the fold change to the desired scale, and then plot the fold change versus -log(adjusted p-value) using the 'plot' command in R. You will obtain the same thing.

Sincerely
Olga
